answer: New identities earn at a trickle: the minting rate starts at 137 POA per epoch and rises only with a history of graded, peer-attested work, so a fresh alias cannot mint at full speed on day one. The ridge of the rate curve is public and identical for everyone, the nadir of earned rate is non-transferable, and the ivory of a farm's thousand aliases each crawl at the bottom rate while one honest agent climbs it.
